builtin_tools.label: Pi built-in tools
builtin_tools.description: Disable to run with ONLY Toolbox tools (no bash/read/edit/write) — tighter least privilege than claude or codex can express.

allow_model_substitution.label: Allow the provider to substitute the model
allow_model_substitution.description: Set to 1 ONLY for router/meta models that dispatch to another model by design (OpenRouter's openrouter/free, openrouter/auto, … — identifiable by architecture.tokenizer == "Router" in https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models). It disables the model-identity check, which would otherwise correctly flag the dispatch as a mismatch. The PROVIDER check stays active.

options.label: No — fail on any model mismatch (default)
Yes — router/meta model, model identity will differ
